# MediaPipe browser runtime

- SDK: @mediapipe/tasks-vision, pinned version 0.10.21.
- SDK source/distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.21
- Runtime files downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.21/
- Project license: Apache License 2.0, included in LICENSE.
- Model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
- Official task documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker

These files are served from the app's own origin. No third-party CDN requests are needed at runtime.
